# dsh-ledger-kitty

A white kitten accountant on the window sill. It is drawn as one inline SVG, so
every part can be an

imated separately and nothing is rasterized at a fixed size;
on top of that it keeps the numbers: co

st of the last answer, cost of the whole
open session and the remaining balance, in one chosen curre

f the last answer, cost of the whole
open session and the remaining balance, in one chosen currency.
## What it does today

- **Stands on the floor** — the default spot is the bottom edge of the window and
the idle motion is

breathing, not vertical floating: the cat never levitates.
- **Idle life** — breathing, a swaying t

ail, random ear twitches, and blinking
every 2–6 seconds.
- **Big eyes follow you** — the pupils tra

ck the mouse pointer across the window.
- **Drag & snap** — drag it anywhere; it springs on drop and

snaps to the nearest
screen edge, including the floor. The position is remembered per browser.
- **

Click = balance** — a silent hop, then the balance card (no chatter).
- **Double click = settings**

— currency, language (English / Русский /
Українська / 中文), and the cat's size (0.5× / 1× / 1.25× /

1.5×). Settings are
remembered per browser. The double click is detected from two pointer-ups
within

400 ms, because pointer capture makes the browser's own `dblclick`
unreliable on this element.
- **

Own language** — the four dictionaries live in `STRINGS`; the picker is
independent of the app local

e, which only seeds the initial value.
- **Right click = menu** — Balance / Settings, so both panels

stay reachable even
if a double click is awkward on a touchpad.
- **Sleeps when you are away** — af

ter 60 seconds without input it closes its eyes
and shows `z z`; any pointer movement wakes it.
- `p
refers-reduced-motion` turns the looping animations off.
## Accountant card

The Host half folds every `assistant/message` event into a per-session ledger and
publishes it on on
e read-only route, `GET /dsh-ledger-kitty/state?session=<id>`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- **After every turn** the cat shows a receipt: tokens and money for this answer,
then the same for

the whole open session, the money the prompt cache saved
(`cacheReadTokens × (miss − hit)`), the con

text size as tokens and percent of
the 1M window, and the remaining balance underneath.
- **Says wha

t is missing** — no account, a signed-out session, a temporary
failure, no network or an unreachable

Host each get their own line under the
balance instead of a bare dash: “Аккаунт DeepSeek не подключ

ён”, “Войдите в
аккаунт DeepSeek”, “Не удалось получить баланс”, “Нет сети — курсы
недоступны”, “Hos

t не отвечает”. A failed balance read is retried on the next
poll and is never cached; a missing exc

hange rate renders as “—” and never as
`$0.00`.
- **Peak countdown** — the receipt ends with `непик

· через 1 ч 15 мин`: the Host
returns the next Beijing price boundary (`nextChangeAt`), so the cat t

ells you
when the cheap tariff starts.
- **Clicking the cat** shows just the balance, without a spee

ch bubble.
- The session ledger is seeded from the session's existing events when the Host
first see

s it, so the “session” number covers the whole conversation rather than
only the turns since the app

started.
- Cost comes from the durable usage (`inputTokens`, `cacheReadTokens`,
`outputTokens`) tim

es the CNY price table; weekday peak hours in Beijing
(09:00–12:00, 14:00–18:00) double the price.
-

**One display currency.** Settings (double click, or right click → Settings)
offer every currency i

n the live table, popular ones first; costs and balance
are converted into the chosen unit, so a USD

wallet and CNY pricing never mix.
- **Live rates, no typing.** The Host fetches `https://open.er-ap

i.com/v6/latest/CNY`
(keyless), caches it for six hours and includes the whole table in the state

## Agent reactions

The cat watches the agent through the standard Slot hooks `useSessions` and
`useSessionStatus` (root

-scope hooks provided by `ui-session`); it reads only the
main-view session, so a background subagen
t does not make it celebrate.

- **Working** — while the agent runs, the cat taps its front paws alternately,
bobs faster, flicks i

ts tail and looks down at its paws; it also refuses to fall
asleep for the duration of the turn.
- *

*Waiting for you** — when a question or an approval request is pending, one paw
goes up, the ears pe

rk, a `!` badge appears and the bubble says “Нужен твой ответ”.
- **Finished** — when every running

session stops, the cat jumps once, throws
hearts and says “Готово!”.
- **Petted** — stroking the hea

d with the cursor (no click needed) closes the
eyes, wags the tail and releases hearts; the cat purr

s only while the hand
moves and for 0.8 s after it stops. One stroke cycle needs ~140 px of cursor
t

ravel, so a single pass over the head does not trigger it.
- **Idle** — with nothing running it retu
rns to breathing, blinking and sleeping.
## Sound

All five effects are synthesized in Web Audio (src/client/audio.js):
no audio files, no licensing, n

e synthesized in Web Audio (src/client/audio.js):
no audio files, no licensing, nothing to download.
| Sound | When | How it is made |

| `meow` | click on the cat | sawtooth with a pitch envelope through a band-pass formant |
[该节后续省略]
## Why SVG and not a PNG sequence

The cat is a rig, not a picture: head, ears, tail, body and four legs are separate
groups. Movement
is CSS transforms on those groups, so:

- the typing tap is two phase-shifted leg rotations plus a small body bob;
- the jump is squash-and-
no frame assets, no fixed resolution, and the whole character is about 10 KB.

A PNG (or sprite-sheet) sequence only wins when the art needs painted texture
(fur, watercolor, pixe

l art). Then 8–12 frames per action are stored and played
with `steps()`. The behavior layer would s

tay the same; only the art layer would
be swapped.
